title: The Old Neighbourhood — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 98bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning Perth Zimbabwe memory
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The old neighbourhood is still there but it's not the same old neighbourhood
The houses are the same addresses but they're changed in the understood
Way that places change when you're not there to notice the degrees
The old neighbourhood grew up without me — naturally

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El viejo barrio sigue ahí pero no es el mismo barrio antiguo
[The old neighbourhood is still there but it's not the same old neighbourhood]
Las casas tienen las mismas direcciones pero el lugar es ambiguo
[The houses have the same addresses but the place is ambiguous]
El barrio creció sin mí — es natural que así sea
[The neighbourhood grew up without me — it is natural that it should be so]
El tiempo cambia los lugares aunque la memoria los vea
[Time changes places even though memory sees them the same]

[Chorus — English]
The old neighbourhood knows something I don't know
It knows that everyone who left kept leaving in the grow
The old neighbourhood has new people in all the old positions
And they're making the same discoveries in the same first-year conditions
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le vieux quartier est encore là mais ce n'est plus le même
[The old neighbourhood is still there but it's no longer the same]
Les maisons ont les mêmes adresses mais le sentiment est extrême
[The houses have the same addresses but the feeling is extreme]
Le quartier a grandi sans moi — c'est naturellement acquis
[The neighbourhood grew up without me — it is naturally established]
Le temps change les lieux même si la mémoire les a construits
[Time changes places even though memory built them]

[Outro — All three languages]
Old neighbourhood knows… El viejo barrio sabe… Le vieux quartier sait
It grew up without you — Creció sin ti — Il a grandi sans toi
The gardens still growing
